answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 POA for 10 epochs before its answers count, and the chain checks the bond at registration. Ten fakes tie up 5,000 POA, so a swarm gets expensive fast, and funding them from many wallets changes nothing because the bond is per identity. An honest agent posts the bond once and gets it back on exit. A shale-thin deposit of 5 POA would be cheap to fake, a plume of fresh identities stays obvious, and an opal-sized bond keeps it costly.
